title: Direct config.featureToggles access is lint-flagged; use OpenFeature instead
answers: Why did eslint-suppressions.json entry for my file disappear after migrating a flag?
What is the @grafana/no-config-feature-toggles eslint rule enforcing?
Can I read config.featureToggles.<flag> directly in a component?
body: Symptom: a file reading `config.featureToggles.<name>` has a pre-existing suppression entry in eslint-suppressions.json for `@grafana/no-config-feature-toggles`. Root cause: direct config.featureToggles access bypasses OpenFeature and is disallowed by lint except where explicitly suppressed. Fix pattern: replace the direct read with `getFeatureFlagClient().getBooleanValue(FlagKeys.X, default)` or a generated `useFlagX()` hook (both from '@grafana/runtime/internal'), then remove the now-unneeded suppression entry for that file/count in eslint-suppressions.json. Constraints: applies to frontend TSX/TS files checking feature toggles; does not apply to Go backend flag checks.
applies: Frontend code in public/app checking feature toggle values

Remove the suppression entry from eslint-suppressions.json once replaced. Example: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/VizPanelSubHeader.tsx. Constraint: applies to frontend TSX/TS files only, not Go backend flag checks. Applies to any frontend code checking feature toggle values.
